Aria (ops): Published the RCA for today's serving incident — link: https://redwood.company/rca/2743214321 :link:
Aria (ops): TL;DR — ~20m latency spike impacting ~3% of traffic on dedicated pools. Trigger was an autoscaler race condition that exposed a tokenizer version mismatch in one model bundle.
Aria (ops): Impact window 02:12–02:32 UTC. No data exfiltration. Customers on Dedicated saw transient 5xx and elevated tail latency.
Aria (ops): Quick bullet actions from the RCA:
- ACTION 1 (P0): Autoscaler race fix — owner: Ben (infra) — target: 3 business days
- ACTION 2 (P1): Deploy tokenizer version check in CI/CD that blocks model bundles with mismatch — owner: Sasha (product) — target: 1 week
- ACTION 3 (P1): Canary + cross-region failover rule for dedicated pools — owner: Marta (sre) — target: 2 weeks
- ACTION 4 (P2): Add a synthetic prompt-based regression test for tokenizer drift — owner: Keisha (pm) — target: next sprint
Aria (ops): Asking owners to add tasks to the Incident board and update status by EOD tomorrow. Also scheduling a 30min follow-up office hours to walk through the fix plan.
Aria (ops): Office hours: Thu 15:00 UTC (invite sent). Please comment here if you can't attend.
Ben (infra): Got it. I pushed a diagnostic branch, will open WIP PR today. Quick note — repro steps are in the RCA but here's the core check we used:
Ben (infra): ```bash
# check for concurrent scale-downs that race with deploy
jq '.pods[] | select(.phase=="Terminating")' cluster-state.json | wc -l
```
Ben (infra): Will include a unit test for the scaler state machine and a brief fuzz run.
Sasha (product): I can own the CI blocker check. Question: do we want to block deploys only for dedicated model bundles or all bundles? Prefer start with dedicated then roll out.
Marta (sre): I'll draft the canary policy. Also volunteering to run the first-week manual validations post-fix.
Keisha (pm): I'll add the regression test story to the model stability epic and notify affected customers with a short summary and mitigations note.
Lena (cto): Thanks Aria and team — clear RCA and actionable owners. Prioritize the autoscaler fix; consider an emergency backport if needed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-03-14T03:40Z — triggered synthetic canary against staging (no customer impact).
Aria (ops): Reminder: please update the Incident board card with links to PRs and tests before the office hours so we can go over blockers quickly.
Ben (infra): Will post PR link here when ready.
Sasha (product): Marking CI check as WIP in the board.
Marta (sre): Confirmed office hours invite received.
Keisha (pm): I'll coordinate customer comms draft with legal and support.
Aria (ops): Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. Will reopen with office hours notes and check-in summary after the meeting. :eyes:
